column2: DANGER SF6 Cylinder Storage Sign – Leaking Gas Sinks and Displaces Oxygen – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Leaking Gas Sinks and Displaces Oxygen. This DANGER SF6 Cylinder Storage sign from CGAP Safety reads: SF6 CYLINDER STORAGE / LEAKING GAS SINKS AND / DISPLACES OXYGEN / NEVER STORE IN PITS / OR BASEMENTS. Written for electric utility substations, switching stations and power plants and utility warehouses.

Why this sign matters

Leaking SF6 is several times heavier than air and collects in low areas where it displaces oxygen without odor.

Where to post it

Cylinder cage or room.

Who orders it

Substation supervisor, warehouse manager.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: IEC 62271-4; CGA P-1. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
